svg.title: Jungle: failure recovery paths
svg.text: Persist the state first. Retries must not repeat the financial effect.
Commit succeeded, consumer crashed before ack
SQS redelivery → inbox + idempotency → saved result, no second debit.
The database protects the balance beyond the FIFO deduplication window.
Event sent, publisher crashed before marking it
Outbox retry → possible duplicate event → consumers deduplicate by eventId.
At-least-once, not exactly-once. Projections consider walletVersion.
Refund / rollback arrives before its reference
PENDING_REFERENCE → persistent worker retries → process or expire.
Transient failure: backoff. Invalid commands / exhausted retries: DLQ.
Assessment project. No active authentication, load benchmark or public deployment.
